name: CMAT
conductingBody: National Testing Agency (NTA), Ministry of Education, Government of India
cycle: CMAT 2026 (latest completed cycle; exam held 25 Jan 2026, result 17 Feb 2026). As of 2026-11-11 the CMAT site's About page mentions CMAT-2027 for Academic Session 2027-28, but no CMAT 2027 information bulletin or public notice has been released; the Information Bulletin link still points to the CMAT 2026 bulletin.
eligibility: The candidate must hold a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Candidates appearing for the final year of Bachelor's Degree, whose result will be declared before commencement of admission for academic year 2026-27, can also apply. The candidate must be a citizen of India. There is no age restriction.
frequency: Once a year (single exam date). CMAT 2026 was held on 25 January 2026 in a single shift (09:00 AM to 12:00 PM). The bulletin notes the exam may be held in multiple shifts depending on candidate numbers.

pattern.marking: Each question carries 4 marks (+4 for a correct response); 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response; no marks for unanswered questions. Each section has a maximum of 80 marks, 400 in total (100 questions).
pattern.notes: Medium of question paper: English only. No section-wise time limits are stated in the bulletin (minutes: null). For multi-shift papers, raw marks are converted to NTA scores (normalization, Appendix VIII). Tie-break: same score ranked by date of birth (older first). Figures are from the CMAT 2026 information bulletin.

resultAndCounselling: Result is declared on https://cmat.nta.nic.in only; candidates download score cards from the website (no dispatch, no re-evaluation). The CMAT score is accepted by all AICTE-Approved Institutions / University Departments / Constituent Colleges / Affiliated Colleges. NTA's role ends at declaring results, hosting score cards and providing result data to AICTE; NTA has no role in counselling. Candidates must apply separately to participating institutions, which release their own cut-off CMAT scores and may hold Group Discussion and Personal Interview for final selection. For institutes run/aided/recognized by State Governments, the respective state reservation policy applies. (State CAPs are not named in NTA documents.) CMAT 2026: 53,453 registered, 41,872 appeared (78.33%), 110 cities, 259 centres.
